_about: Scores the system must not fall below. The gate compares every eval run against these. Update with: python -m eval.gate --update (only after a deliberate improvement).

fake._about: Offline run, no API key, no cost. Embeddings are hashed word counts and the model is a stub, so only retrieval and routing are meaningful here.

openai._about: Full run with real embeddings, real model and model-judged answers. Empty until the first full run sets it: python -m eval.gate --update
